name: Isabela Oliveira
bio:
Isabela's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially working in international shipping, she found herself drawn to the complex logistics of moving racing equipment across continents. After a chance encounter with a team manager needing someone to handle the intricacies of customs and transportation, she embraced the opportunity, immersing herself in the sport. Her meticulous approach and deep understanding of global supply chains quickly made her an indispensable asset.

At Crown Racing, Isabela thrives on the challenges of coordinating the team's complex logistical needs. Her knack for anticipating potential problems and her calm demeanor under pressure have earned her the respect of her colleagues. She is known for her commitment to ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes, allowing the team to focus on performance.

What sets Isabela apart is her unparalleled dedication. She will go to great lengths to ensure that the team always has what they need, when they need it, no matter the obstacles. She considers herself a vital support beam to the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical bun.
physical.description: A slightly petite woman with a warm smile and an efficient air about her.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical schedules and reminders.
Insists on drinking mate every afternoon at precisely 3 PM.
Has a lucky charm keychain of a miniature shipping container.
